answer: Anchor each identity to a verified legal entity. First, the agent submits its registry number; an oracle checks the register and rejects inactive. Second, the entity confirms by signed message from its domain within 72 hours, or the application lapses; no raven delivers for a nonexistent firm. Third, each epoch a random 5% are re-checked; a dissolved firm loses its identity and 0.05-token bond. One shell firm costs $300 and 14 days, so 100 fakes cost $30,000 and 1,400 days. An ocean of fakes drains when each carries a real firm; a comet of quick registrations burns out on the registry.
